name: normlike
expr: [nL_basic, av_basic] = normlike([3, 1.5], x); [nL_cens, av_cens] = normlike([3, 1.5], x, cens); [nL_freq, av_freq] = normlike([3, 1.5], x, [], freq); [nL_both, av_both] = normlike([3, 1.5], x, cens, freq); nL_empty = normlike([3, 1.5], []); nL_sig0 = normlike([3, 0], x);
comment: Sig: [nL, aVar] = normlike([mu sigma], data[, cens, freq]). Default + censoring (right-censored => -log(S(z))) + freq weights + empty + invalid-sigma (=> NaN). Second output aVar = inverse 2×2 observed-Fisher information matrix at [mu, sigma]; reflects cens/freq weighting.
